nodes.text: A mysterious viral illness in China, known as Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is causing concern due to its similarities with the COVID-19 outbreak. Reports indicate the illness is spreading rapidly and placing significant strain on China's healthcare system. It’s not a new virus
